column1:
A web application allows users to upload documents, but only specific file formats are supported.
Supported file types: .pdf, .docx, .txt

column2: Upload a file without an extension (e.g., readme)
Upload a renamed file (e.g., virus.pdf but actually an .exe)
Upload one valid + one invalid file in the same group
Try to drag and drop a valid file instead of using the upload button
